coverage.delegated: Independent Standards/state agent owns frontend drafts, API/router/database idempotency and account isolation; root owns screenshot/live browser, Oracle deployment and new actual native rendering verification.

findings.issue: An explicit assistant-supplied PNG path bypassed current-thread provenance checks and accepted another recent session's image.
findings.red: Executable fake CLI emitted completed thread A with generatedImagePath in other-thread; nativeRunner returned the foreign path.
findings.fix: All image responses select exactly one fresh regular exec-*.png from the completed thread itself; assistant path is never authoritative.
tests: native explicit image paths cannot substitute another thread or a symlink receipt
a completed native image turn recovers only its own single fresh PNG when Luna omits the path

findings.issue: Import and repack followed storage/output symlinks; lexical privacy checks accepted a public storage alias. stat/readFile opened different pathname identities and allocated an unbounded file before checking its final size.
findings.red: Importer succeeded through characters->external, dataDir->public and arena.sqlite->other-storage; pack followed bundle->external and rewrote its manifest; bundle/source and generic reads followed symlinks.
findings.fix: Canonical privacy checks, no-follow directory/file opens, pinned root/characters/temp/bundle descriptors, hard bounded descriptor reads, SQLite/sidecar symlink rejection, identity checks before commit, atomic replacement of pack outputs and private temp modes. Repack applies generation's private/web-served path gate.
tests: import cannot follow its characters directory outside private storage
import resolves private storage aliases before rejecting a public destination
import rejects a symlinked database before modifying another storage root
bounded reads reject symlinks even when their target is a valid small file
bundle rejects in-directory source symlinks rather than accepting resolved aliases
manual repacking cannot follow a bundle symlink and erase outside manifests
a pinned bundle directory cannot be redirected by a parent rename and symlink swap
import ignores hostile prepacked files and commits only recomputed private owner assets
manual repacking rejects web-served jobs without modifying their manifests
findings.trustBoundary: Private operator/storage/config remain trusted against same-UID writers. SQLite lstat/open and lower configuration changes are not claimed atomically isolated from a malicious same-UID process.

findings.issue: Read-only Codex still exposed command execution and inherited integrations able to read credentials. Empty mcp_servers={} did not remove inherited configured servers.
findings.red: Runtime argument regression failed absent shell/hooks/plugin disables. Real pinned CLI with synthetic configured server showed mcp_servers={} retained it enabled; quoted dotted-key overrides also failed CLI parsing.
findings.fix: Disable shell execution/snapshots/hooks/plugins/apps/subagents. Enumerate MCP configuration with sanitized env and matching cwd, then apply exact server-name enabled=false values using a TOML inline table; fail closed on enumeration/parse errors without exposing stdout/stderr. Real pinned CLI verifies odd names with dots, spaces and quotes.
tests: both Codex phases select Luna High without forwarding API credentials
pinned Codex CLI really disables configured MCP servers with quoted dotted names
MCP enumeration fails closed without exposing subprocess output or starting a turn

findings.issue: Late cancellation during character.json writing still returned an importable ready pack; edited invalid job metadata left an older manifest importable.
findings.red: Real fs.watch aborted at character.json rename but pack resolved successfully. A preexisting manifest survived invalid edited design.json.
findings.fix: Revoke prior manifest before metadata parsing; check abort after final JSON writes; remove manifest on every pack failure/cancellation.
tests: repacking failure revokes an earlier manifest before validating edited job metadata
abort during the last packing writes cannot leave an importable manifest

findings.issue: Eight exact repeated poses passed geometry/transparency and produced a ready character.
findings.red: An atlas with eight identical shapes passed both normalization and direct packing.
findings.fix: Reject exact repeated cropped visible RGBA pose signatures plus dimensions in normalization and direct packing. Valid fixtures now use geometrically distinct poses; no approximate similarity heuristic was added.
tests: eight exact repeated poses fail both normalization and direct packing

findings.issue: A configured key with omitted ARENA_CREATOR_ENABLED enabled paid visitor generation despite the staged-billing gate.
findings.fix: Default disabled; only explicit true enables the API provider. Invalid values still fail startup.
tests: production generation can be held disabled with a configured key

findings.issue: The design turn exposed the native image tool despite the workflow authorizing rendering only in drawing.
findings.red: Contract assertion requiring features.image_generation=false on design failed.
findings.fix: Typed per-turn image-generation capability false for design and true for drawing; both reasoning phases remain gpt-6-luna/high.
